meaning:
προσ-κλίνω
[in LXX: 2Ma.14:24 * ;]
1. to make to lean against.
2. to make the scale incline one way or another; hence, metaphorically, of persons, to incline (sc. ἑαυτόν) towards: pass., Act.5:36.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: For before these days Theudas rose up, making himself out to be somebody; to whom a number of men, about four hundred, joined themselves. He was slain; and…
